text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Forgive me... I have sustained 
quite a severe wound.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I've always made sure to "look before 
leaping," but I let my guard down for just 
a moment...
choice_data_list: No, I'm the one who should apologize.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's not something you need to apologize 
for, Trainer. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps this is—an opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Stepping outside of your own mold is 
quite difficult. However...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(When the body loses its freedom, new 
techniques are often born. In this 
moment——)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, may I get back to training now?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes a handicap can lead to 
ingenuity. So please... have faith.
choice_data_list: Got it! Don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Understood. Then I will give up.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If that is your decision after 
thinking it over, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
For now—I will wait. For the wound to 
heal... patiently.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll give it a try, somehow.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The important thing is to avoid putting 
strain on the affected area. For that to 
happen...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Digging deep into the work is vital. 
Carefully consider the purpose of the 
training—!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Kuh!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No way... And here I thought I could do 
it...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
“I'm so pathetic. My thinking was far too 
na... ive...”

The attempt failed. Believe ended up 
aggravating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Did I... hold back?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer. Even in this state, I 
didn't lose my balance.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
With this, we can avoid falling behind 
schedule.

A narrow escape from death, finding life 
amidst peril. Believe adapted her running 
style and overcame the crisis.
